messages:
Ana P. (People Ops): Quick coordination thread — onsite interview for Kaito Tanaka (Seattle office) next Wed 9/14. Candidate flies in from Japan, lands 08:30 PDT. Need: panel availability confirmation, parking permit, travel reimbursement process (international receipts), accessibility notes (lower desk / quiet room option), and remote fallback link in case of late arrival.
Jordan L. (Recruiter): Thanks — Kaito asked for a slightly later start if possible (can do 10:00–1:00 PT window). He mentioned no dietary restrictions but prefers vegetarian lunch. I already told him parking is available but will confirm permit.
Sam R. (Backend Eng): I can do 10:30–12:00 PT for interviews. 11:00 slot preferred.
Maria G. (Office Admin): I can reserve Conf B (ground floor) and a quiet room nearby. Need license plate for the parking permit — can someone ask candidate? Also can set up a lower-height desk and a spare ergonomic mouse.
Jordan L. (Recruiter): @Maria G. I'll ask Kaito for the plate and any mobility needs. He said no assistive devices but prefers a quiet room. I'll DM him now.
Ana P. (People Ops): Reimbursement notes: international receipts are fine, but we need original receipts and a short currency conversion note on the expense form. Use the Travel Expenses form: https://redwood.example/expensify (or file via Concur). For taxi from SEA airport, we pre-approve up to $80. For reimbursement, ask candidate to email scans to travel@redwood.com within 30 days.
Sam R. (Backend Eng): Remote fallback — can we have a Zoom link ready in case he hits customs? Also will interviewers join 10 min early?
it-bot: Calendar event created: "Onsite Interview — Kaito Tanaka" Wed Sep 14 10:30–12:30 PT — https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abcdefg (rooms: Conf B + Quiet Room).
Maria G. (Office Admin): Parking permit booked for 9/14 validated to license PLT-TO-VERIFY. Jordan, once you send plate I'll update permit. Catering: vegetarian boxed lunches ordered for 11:30.
Jordan L. (Recruiter): Plate = "TBA" (candidate checking). I'll update by EOD today. Also shared travel reimbursement steps with Kaito and included a PDF with sample currency conversion.
Ana P. (People Ops): Quick checklist before day: 1) Confirm plate and update permit, 2) Confirm arrival ETA with candidate, 3) Send panel itinerary + Zoom fallback to candidate 24h prior, 4) Ensure IT has spare laptop and dongles in Quiet Room.
Sam R. (Backend Eng): Confirmed — I'll be there 15 min early and can bring a spare HDMI dongle.
Maria G. (Office Admin): Quiet Room setup: lower desk, spare monitor, dongles, and signage "Interview in progress".
Jordan L. (Recruiter): I'll send final itinerary + Zoom fallback at least 24h prior and CC travel@redwood.com for receipts questions. Thanks all :thumbsup:
Ana P. (People Ops): Perfect — mark this as the canonical thread for day-of ops. If anything changes ping here. :spiral_calendar:
